title: Unlocking the potential of cysteine–xylose Maillard reaction intermediates as natural flavor precursors: a comprehensive study on flavor regulation, storage stability, and antioxidant activity
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,3239-3252
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00932D, Paper
Open Access

Di Kang, Lin Jiang, Songjin Zheng, Yuan Hu, Haifeng Wang, Teng Li, Yuying Fu, Yun Zhai
2-Threityl-thiazolidine-4-carboxylic acid (TTCA) and Amadori rearrangement products (ARPs), intermediates of a cysteine–xylose (Cys–Xyl) Maillard reaction system, have been proven to form desirable flavors during thermal processing.
